stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip socket in the leather boot = gimbal (X roll / Y pitch)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), Super Libra (J1) joystick base without grip, seen from the front-left corner and above; grip socket inside the leather boot on top, SUPER LIBRA logo plate on the near face
mappingSource: catalog: WinWing "J1 SUPER LIBRA JOYSTICK BASE Manual EN V1.1" (https://en.winwing.cn/static/file/J1-SUPER%20LIBRA%20JOYSTICK%20BASE-MANUAL%20EN%20V%201.1.pdf); X = roll, Y = pitch (standard stick axes, catalog)
note: The base has no buttons or twist; the gimbal marker sits on the grip socket in the boot. Discontinued base, PID unknown (catalog).
